"Very well, corporal.|The corporal and Lieutenant Lyste|}} A [[Gender|male]] '''stormtrooper corporal''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] as a [[deck officer]] during the [[Standard year|year]] [[3 BBY]]. Serving with [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]], the [[stormtrooper]] [[corporal]] was one of several Imperials assigned to oversee the safety of three [[Alderaan]]ian [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] that had come to Lothal in order to deliver relief aide to the famished civilians. Alongside a [[scanning crew]], the corporal inspected the [[corvette]]s for contraband, but they did not find any. Later in the [[Standard day|day]], the [[Spectres|rebel Spectres group]]—who were secretly in league with the ships' [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|overseer]]—[[Mission on Lothal|raided]] the [[Lothal Depot|depot]] where the ships were being held. The corporal attempted to stop the rebels, but he was subdued by rebel [[Ezra Bridger]]. The [[Stormtrooper Commander|stormtrooper commanding officer]] regained consciousness shortly after the rebels flew off with all three Hammerhead corvettes. ==Biography== ===The arrival of Princess Leia=== {{Quote|Deck officer, I'd like to start distributing my relief aide."
"Stand by. My orders are to inspect the cargo for contraband and detain these vessels until the lieutenant arrives.|Princess Leia Organa and the stormtrooper corporal|}} [[File:Stormtroopers_watch_the_Hammerheads.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The stormtrooper corporal watches the Alderaan corvettes land on Lothal.]] A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] lived during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]] and served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[stormtrooper]]. By the [[Standard year|year]] [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[A Princess on Lothal]]" to [[3 BBY]]. the trooper was stationed on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] with the [[military rank]] of [[corporal]], and further served as the [[deck officer]] of the [[Lothal Depot]] near the [[city]] of [[Jalath]] in the position [[Stormtrooper Commander]].''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' At some point, Lothal was visited by a delegation from the planet [[Alderaan]], who had been given permission from the [[Imperial Senate]] to deliver relief aide to the famished Lothal civilians. The delegation consisted of three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] under the leadership of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. The corporal, along with a two-man [[scanning crew]], received the delegation at the depot, unaware that the ships were intended to fall into the hands of the [[Phoenix Cell|local rebellion]]. Upon meeting Organa face-to-face, she requested that she be able to begin delivering her relief aide. The corporal informed her that before she could do that, he and his crew had to inspect the cargo for contraband, and then wait for the arrival of [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]], Organa's liaison for the relief mission. The corporal then continued with his scanning operation. During the time of the scan, Organa had Lyste hand over his own transport for her personal use. Along with two disguised rebels, [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Ezra Bridger]], Organa helped rescue the Imperial prisoner [[Ryder Azadi]] and fake her own capture. Shortly after the rescue, the corporal finished his scan after finding no contraband. He reported his findings to Lyste in person, shortly before Lyste received news of the abductions of Azadi and Organa. ===Theft of the Hammerhead corvettes=== {{Quote|Sir, rebels!"
"Blast them!|The corporal and Lyste, shortly before the former opens fire on Ryder Azadi|}} [[File:LysteAndLeiaWithStormtroopers-SWRS02E12.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The corporal and Lyste watch as the corvettes are stolen.]] After nightfall, Organa returned to the depot aboard the [[scout]] [[Starship|ship]] ''[[Phantom]]''. The corporal, Lyste, and another stormtrooper leveled [[blaster]]s at the princess, at which point Organa claimed that the stormtrooper and Imperial [[cadet]] that were with her rescued her from the rebels. Lyste pushed the corporal's [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]] away from the princess and apologized for the misunderstanding. In truth, the stormtrooper and cadet were Jarrus and Bridger, respectively. However, more rebels [[Mission on Lothal|arrived]] shortly after to steal the Hammerhead [[corvette]]s. The corporal spotted Azadi freeing the ships from their [[gravity lock]]s, and Lyste ordered his troopers to open fire. Azadi escaped immediate danger when rebel [[Sabine Wren]] took control of one of the corvette's weapon systems and fired at the Imperials, knocking the corporal to the ground. Lyste and the troopers refocused their weapons, but Jarrus and Bridger sprung into action, with Jarrus subduing Lyste and the stormtrooper. Before the corporal could react, Bridger jumped onto his shoulders and began to beat the deck officer with his bare hands. After a brief struggle, Bridger tore off the corporal's helmet, knocked him to the ground, and knocked him out with a forceful punch to the face. Azadi, Jarrus and Bridger escaped in the last two corvettes, while Organa allowed herself to be stunned by Bridger to make herself appear a victim of the rebels. Lyste, the corporal, and the stormtrooper regained conscious shortly after the rebels departed, and Lyste apologized profusely to Organa for losing her ships. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Scanning crew, move out.|The stormtrooper corporal conducts a cargo investigation|}} A male individual, the stormtrooper corporal followed his orders as directed. When speaking to Princess Organa, the corporal remained polite but asserted that his orders superseded her personal requests. The stormtrooper was attentive, as he had spotted Azadi working to free the corvettes out in the open while Lyste and the other trooper were occupied with the princess. ==Equipment== The corporal wore standard [[stormtrooper armor]] along with a black [[pauldron]] that allowed him to stand out against the other stormtroopers. The corporal used an E-11 [[blaster rifle]] during the rebel raid on Lothal. ==Behind the scenes== The stormtrooper corporal appeared in the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', titled "[[A Princess on Lothal]]." The trooper played a supporting role in the episode, but was not identified by name or a [[callsign]]. The character was credited as "Stormtrooper Deck Officer" and was voiced by [[Steve Blum]]. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-episode-guide|text="A Princess on Lothal" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{Databank|hammerhead-corvette|Hammerhead Corvette}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|yogar-lyste|Supply Master Yogar Lyste}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtrooper officers of the Galactic Empire]]
